description: This file defines an Android activity class 'WebContentActivity' that displays HTML content from the app's assets folder within a WebView. It provides a static method to create intents for launching the activity with a specific HTML file, and manages WebView settings, focus behavior for TV navigation, and handling of back button presses.

classes.name: WebContentActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays web content within a WebView, designed to display HTML files stored in the assets folder, with focus management for Android TV navigation and back button handling.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch WebContentActivity with a specified asset HTML file path.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the WebView, sets up its settings, focus management, and loads the specified HTML file from assets.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back button presses to close the activity, allowing other keys to be processed normally.
